{{Top|leg}}
'''Ammonium nitrate''' was the nitrate of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]], and could be used both as a fertilizer and an explosive. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[Jelph Marrian]] used this compound to booby-trap his [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|starfighter]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]], her guards and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Sawj Luzo|Sawj]] and [[Flen Luzo]].

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ammonium nitrate is in fact a real-world chemical compound used as a fertiliser and cost-effective mining explosive.
